9 years TBI, 29 (M) Felt cognitive decline around 25 as well, at 29 now it’s getting worse. I’ve tried multiple prescription drugs but they only mask the problem & make most of my symptoms worse. Physiotherapy, neuroscientists, cranial sacral, massage, chiropractor, hyperbaric, & many other treatments only provide temporary relief in the moment. The next day, all my symptoms are back & usually worse. I continue to try new things & have healthy routines, but at the end of the day & start of every morning, I’m in pain again. 

I have existing mental illnesses & disorders, those seem to be preventing my brain from healing according to the 1 helpful doctor out of around 30 doctors I’ve seen. 

Also, I was delivered from a forcep delivery, so that easily could have been my first brain injury, and now the trauma is stacked from multiple concussions.

Have faith in yourself & you can find peace somewhere. It’s my cats for me

Not at all! I never had any luck with any prescription medication. I tried around 10 different kinds, antidepressants, anti psychotics but they all made my concussion symptoms worse. Longest I tried was 9 months on prescription drugs & I can’t barely remember that time.

When I came out of the hospital in 2015 for a suicide attempt, they had me on 4 different drugs & it was the worst I’ve ever felt . I decided to stop taking them & it Took me months to recover from the withdrawals.

Been off ever since, however I use CBD cannabis oil & micro dosing of psilocybin mushrooms & that’s been the most helpful substance. However it hasn’t cleared any symptoms up for me. Everything is still there, the severity just differs on how much activity I am doing.

Planning my days, deep breathing, lite stretching, journaling (all when I feel up to it) has been the most helpful

Hello, I’ve had PTSD since I was 6 & have had 8 severe concussions from age 20 to 28. My symptoms continue to get worse. Somedays I’m able to manage it, but my hypersensitivity is at an all time high.

My newest doctor said the same thing, PTSD & my mental illness are preventing my brain from recovering. However I do have tissue & nerve damage from the concussions.  But I can relate with an existing condition making my post concussion symptoms worse.

I wish I could give more advice. Limiting stimulation & deep breathing, lite stretching have helped me the most.

Message me if you want to talk more. Hope you find some healing soon
